Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

dendromatic 0.2.0

  • apply_breaks_and_shift() split into composable steps: dm_level_breaks(), dm_erase_dormancy(), dm_align_seasons(), dm_rebase_zero(). dm_clean_series() composes them in the original sequence; output remains byte-identical to the toolkit implementation (enforced by the parity test). apply_breaks_and_shift() stays as an exported alias.
  • Progress is now also signalled via ‘progressr’ (new Import): wrap calls in progressr::with_progress() or Shiny’s withProgressShiny() handler. The terminal text bar is unchanged.
  • New synthetic example dataset dendro_sample (two series, two seasons, one reinstallation step, one gap; data-raw/dendro_sample.R).
  • Two vignettes: “Getting started with dendromatic” and “How break leveling works”.
  • pkgdown site configuration and GitHub Actions (R CMD check matrix + pkgdown deploy).

dendromatic 0.1.0

Initial package release (GitHub/r-universe stage; not on CRAN).

  • Code extracted verbatim from the DendroMatic pipeline_helpers.R (toolkit canonical copy, 2026-11-03). No behavior changes.
  • New dm_* API names; every original name is kept as an exported alias (raw_to_L0(), apply_breaks_and_shift(), …) so existing scripts and the DendroMatic Shiny apps keep working unchanged.
  • treenetproc (GitHub-only) moved to Suggests: all call sites guarded, core break/level/normalize logic works without it.
  • Interactive datacleanr session glue (run_interactive_cleaning(), prep_for_dcr(), …) intentionally NOT included — it stays app-side.
  • Planned for 0.2.0: split apply_breaks_and_shift() into composable steps (dm_level_breaks(), dm_erase_dormancy(), dm_align_seasons(), dm_rebase_zero()) behind a golden-file equivalence gate; progressr progress signalling; sample dataset + quick-start vignette.
